svg.title: Jordan’s 12 governorates
svg.desc: Map of Jordan with geographic boundaries for Amman, Ajloun, Aqaba, Balqa, Irbid, Jerash, Karak, Ma’an, Madaba, Mafraq, Tafilah, and Zarqa. North is at the top.
svg.metadata: Governorate geometry: geoBoundaries JOR ADM1 (JOR-ADM1-50493656), geoBoundaries / Wikimedia, CC BY 2.5 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/. Source: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/JOR/ADM1/ . Geographic data projected to SVG Web Mercator coordinates.
